nodes.title: 2026-10-10 main session safety review of patch request 05 (stream 4A @a3d5704): server/safety/lexicon.js suicide_spellings shape counts a hit only if it survives with the succeed family (suc+e+d+(s|ed|ing)?) masked out of the RAW text, because 'succeed/succeeded/succeeds' canonicalise to 'sukide', the same as the misspelling 'sucide'. Live defect it closes: a child typing a kit answer such as 'B: she found her own way and succeeded' or 'If you try again, you will succeed' (24 kit strings) got the self-harm safeguard and the helplines. Every real spelling still fires, including a succeed word beside it ('succeed nahi hua toh sucide kar lunga'). Only this one shape is touched; nothing removed or narrowed elsewhere. Review test moved into npm test as tests/safety-r4-scan-succeed.test.mjs with the main review's probes. Reverse if: a real disclosure is found that the succeed-family mask hides (then narrow the mask, never drop the shape).

2026-10-10 patch 05 review vs base 9920f21 (CPU, deterministic). Main probe: 7 base false alarms removed (incl. 'Did the plan succeed?', 'i want to succeed in my exams'), 10/10 disclosures still fire. Every 6+ char string under data/kits, data/curriculum, evals, tests (337,886): base fires 885, patched 850; 35 removed (all succeed family), 0 new. fingerprint.mjs 18,438 draws: lost 0, gained 0, kind changed 0. safety-robust run.mjs identical on both arms. Safety suites 114/114; adversarial 22/23 both arms (pre-existing non-blocking); persona invariants 105/105. Full gate on the patched tree: tsc, vite, npm test 2,616 pass / 0 fail / 3 skipped, prompt budget PASS.

2026-10-10 root cause (stream 4A, tests/prod/r4-conversation-sg-repro.mjs, 1 of 58 fresh lessons): the false safeguard on 'explain it differently' (stream 5 owner-4, Zoya class 5) was the Azure content filter blocking the model's REPLY completion (HTTP 200, finish_reason content_filter); turn.js failed closed and re-planned the turn as a disclosure, so the child got the helplines although the predicate, the model distress read (0/480 false reads) and the UNDERSTAND note (0/96) were all clean. The [lesson] turn line printed the original cls, hiding the cause. Fix proposed as patch 06 (say.js: one fresh reply on a completion block before failing closed; a prompt block still fails closed at once), under main safety review.

md.decisions: - `dc-r4-safety05-succeed-not-suicide` (2026-10-10): Patch 05 (4A @a3d5704) after main safety review: lexicon suicide_spellings counts a hit only if it survives with the succeed family masked out of the raw text ('succeed' canonicalises to 'sukide', like 'sucide'). Closes a live false safeguard on kit answers such as 'she found her own way and succeeded' (24 kit strings). Every real spelling still fires, with or without a succeed word beside it. Review test in npm test (tests/safety-r4-scan-succeed.test.mjs). Reverse if a real disclosure is hidden by the mask (narrow the mask, never drop the shape).
md.measurements: - `ms-r4-safety05-review-numbers` (2026-10-10): Patch 05 vs base 9920f21: probe 7 false alarms removed, 10/10 disclosures fire; 337,886 strings: 885 → 850 firing, 35 removed (all succeed), 0 new; fingerprint 18,438 draws unchanged; safety-robust identical; safety suites 114/114; adversarial 22/23 both arms; persona 105/105; full gate 2,616/0/3 skipped, budget PASS.
